hub.title: Administration
hub.subtitle: Manage your hospital workspace, clinical structure, and the clinical documents your teams can create.

facilities.description: Sites where care is delivered and encounters take place.

clinicalAreas.title: Clinical areas
clinicalAreas.description: Departments or units within each facility.

disciplines.title: Disciplines
disciplines.description: Clinical specialties within each clinical area.

documents.title: Clinical document catalog
documents.description: Which published forms can be started as clinical documents.

shared.retireDescription: Retired records stay visible for historical documents but can no longer be used for new activity. This can be reversed by an administrator.
shared.emptyDescription: No records match the current view. Add the first one to start configuring this section.
shared.conflictDescription: Another user updated this record while you were editing. Reload to see the latest version, or continue and your changes will be rejected.
shared.notEditableDescription: You can view this section, but you do not have permission to change it.

workspace.title: Hospital workspace
workspace.subtitle: Identify the workspace the current session is configured for.
workspace.name: Workspace name
workspace.nameHelp: A human-readable name shown in administrative UIs.
workspace.nameTooLong: Workspace name must be 256 characters or fewer.
workspace.loadFailed: Could not load the hospital workspace.

facilities.title: Facilities
facilities.subtitle: Facilities are the sites where care is delivered. Encounters and clinical documents reference them.
facilities.createDescription: Facility codes must be unique within the hospital and cannot change after creation.
facilities.codeHelp: A stable code used by clients and URLs. Cannot be changed later.
facilities.codeTooLong: Facility code must be 64 characters or fewer.
facilities.codeInvalid: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
facilities.codeDuplicate: A facility with this code already exists.
facilities.nameTooLong: Facility name must be 256 characters or fewer.
facilities.parentHelp: Facility codes cannot change after creation.

clinicalAreas.title: Clinical areas
clinicalAreas.subtitle: Clinical areas are departments or units within a facility (Facility → Clinical Area → Discipline).
clinicalAreas.createDescription: Clinical area codes must be unique within the hospital and cannot change after creation. The parent facility is fixed at creation.
clinicalAreas.codeHelp: A stable code used by clients and URLs. Cannot be changed later.
clinicalAreas.codeTooLong: Clinical area code must be 64 characters or fewer.
clinicalAreas.codeInvalid: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
clinicalAreas.codeDuplicate: A clinical area with this code already exists.
clinicalAreas.nameTooLong: Clinical area name must be 256 characters or fewer.
clinicalAreas.facilityEmpty: Create a facility before adding clinical areas.
clinicalAreas.parentHelp: The parent facility is fixed at creation and cannot be changed.

disciplines.title: Disciplines
disciplines.subtitle: Disciplines are clinical specialties within a clinical area (Facility → Clinical Area → Discipline).
disciplines.createDescription: Discipline codes must be unique within the hospital and cannot change after creation. The parent clinical area is fixed at creation.
disciplines.codeHelp: A stable code used by clients and URLs. Cannot be changed later.
disciplines.codeTooLong: Discipline code must be 64 characters or fewer.
disciplines.codeInvalid: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
disciplines.codeDuplicate: A discipline with this code already exists.
disciplines.nameTooLong: Discipline name must be 256 characters or fewer.
disciplines.clinicalAreaEmpty: Create a clinical area before adding disciplines.
disciplines.parentHelp: The parent clinical area is fixed at creation and cannot be changed.

documents.title: Clinical document catalog
documents.subtitle: Control which published forms can be started as clinical documents, and where they are available.
documents.createDescription: Document codes must be unique within the hospital. Each entry pins an exact published form version and an organizational scope.
documents.codeTooLong: Document code must be 64 characters or fewer.
documents.codeInvalid: Use letters, numbers, and hyphens only.
documents.codeDuplicate: A document with this code already exists.
documents.nameTooLong: Document name must be 256 characters or fewer.
documents.formEmpty: No published forms are available yet. Publish a form version before adding documents.
documents.versionEmpty: This form has no published versions.
documents.facilityEmpty: Create a facility before adding documents.
documents.multipleInstancesHelp: When off, only one document of this type can be started per encounter.
documents.actorCreation: Require a responsible professional to start
documents.actorCreationHelp: When on, the starting clinician must be identified.
documents.actorCompletion: Require a responsible professional to complete
documents.actorCompletionHelp: When on, the completing clinician must be identified.
documents.emptyDescription: No document catalog entries match the current view.
